GeneDef.label: xenogenes mainframe
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene can freely change their genetic code and the genetic code of those who are connected to the cerebrex core.
GeneDef.resourceDescription: Allows you to freely edit the genes of carriers and pawns that have <color=#8a8ae6>mechlink</color>.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Allows to <color=#8a8ae6>edit xenogenes</color> of pawns that have <color=#8a8ae6>mechlink</color>.
Complexity depends on <color=#8a8ae6>free bandwidth</color>, archites depend on the number of xenotypes <color=#8a8ae6>researched</color>, and metabolism has a limit from -5 to +5.
